subject: Invoice delivery preference and VAT / EIN details for Everleaf Therapeutics
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everleaf.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Everleaf AP <ap-team@everleaf.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AP onboarding + invoice delivery options (PO 8721)

Hi Irene / Laura,

We're getting PO 8721 in place for the pilot work with Redwood. Our AP team is putting together onboarding — attached is the AP form with billing address and remittance notes. Quick questions so we can complete setup on our side:  

- Can Redwood deliver invoices via the vendor portal (preferred) or as emailed PDFs?
- Do you support Peppol or SFTP e-invoice delivery, or only portal/email?
- Please confirm what fields you'll put on the invoice for EU VAT handling (we need: Invoice number, Invoice date, Gross amount, VAT amount or a note for reverse-charge if applicable, and Redwood's VAT / Company reg).
- Our tax details: Everleaf Therapeutics, VAT GB987654321, Company EIN 12-3456789. Please confirm you can include both on the invoice.

Also attaching our PO for reference (everleaf_po_8721.pdf). If portal is available, do you require SSO/SAML, or can we receive invitation links to self-register?

If easier, happy to hop on a 15 min call to confirm.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior AP Analyst
Everleaf Therapeutics
liam.oconnor@everleaf.com
attachments: everleaf_po_8721.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everleaf.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding + invoice delivery options (PO 8721)

Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the onboarding form. Welcome — excited to get Everleaf set up.

Short answers up front:  
- Yes, we can deliver invoices either as emailed PDF attachments or via the Redwood Billing Portal.
- We also support e-invoice transmission (Peppol) and SFTP-based invoice pushes for customers that need automated ingestion.
- We will include Company Registration / VAT ID and the EIN on the invoice PDF. For EU customers, if reverse-charge applies we will add the agreed note and zero-rate VAT lines accordingly — please confirm the preferred text and we'll mirror that on all future invoices.

Next steps I propose:  
1) Rafael (cc'd) from Finance will provision Everleaf in our Billing Portal and can enable Peppol/SFTP if you want.
2) If you want portal-only delivery, we can send an SSO invite (SAML) or a one-time portal setup link; Laura can help with SSO details.
3) While portal access is being set up, we can send the first invoice as an email PDF to accounts-payable@everleaf.com.

Timeline: Rafael, can you confirm typical turnaround for generating the first invoice once AP details are on file? We typically issue within 1 business day after confirmation of PO and billing contact.

Thanks — attaching our sample invoice template for fields we include.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_invoice_template.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everleaf.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Everleaf AP <ap-team@everleaf.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T14:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding + invoice delivery options (PO 8721)

Irene — thanks for the quick reply. Portal + email copies would be ideal for our workflow (portal for invoice ingestion + emailed PDF to keep on file). A couple of clarifications:  

- Confirming VAT: please include VAT GB987654321 and EIN 12-3456789 on the invoice. For our purchasing team the wording for reverse-charge should be: "VAT reverse charge – customer liable to account for VAT under Article 194(1)".
- For the monthly billing question: would Redwood be able to issue a consolidated monthly statement (one invoice for multiple POs) or do you invoice per PO? We prefer consolidated monthly invoices if possible.
- Attaching our AP onboarding form with remittance bank details.

If consolidating monthly is an option, we can share a list of POs to consolidate each month. If not, we can proceed PO-by-PO.

Thanks,
Liam
attachments: everleaf_ap_onboarding_form.pdf

Hi Liam — Rafael from Redwood Finance here. Thanks for the details and the preferred wording for the reverse-charge. A few operational notes and next steps so we can get you fully onboarded:  

1) We'll provision Everleaf in the Redwood Billing Portal today and enable the option to receive invoice copies via email to accounts-payable@everleaf.com. Portal invites can be SAML-based (SSO) or email-based self-registration — whichever you prefer. Please let us know if you want SSO and we'll send SSO metadata to your IdP contact.

2) Consolidated monthly invoicing: we can offer consolidated monthly invoices for customers with multiple cost centers. If you want consolidation, please send a brief mapping of PO numbers to the monthly invoice reference (example: Aug consolidated invoice to include PO 8721, 8722). Otherwise we will invoice per PO by default.

3) Invoice fields: we will include the VAT ID and EIN exactly as provided. For reverse-charge we will add the following note on each line: "VAT reverse charge – customer liable to account for VAT under Article 194(1)" and zero-rate VAT amounts per EU rules.

4) Timeline: once AP form is processed and PO confirmed, we will issue the first invoice within 1 business day. While portal provisioning completes (typically same day), we will email the first PDF invoice to accounts-payable@everleaf.com.

Action items:
- Liam: confirm whether you want SSO (SAML) or a standard portal invite link for onboarding.
- Liam: confirm whether you want consolidated monthly invoicing (yes/no) and, if yes, provide the initial list of POs to include.

I've attached our internal invoice template and a short note on VAT/EIN placement so your accounting team can verify the fields match your system.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
